---
title: Chapter numbering with shifted headings
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
number-sections: true
shift-heading-level-by: -1
crossref:
  chapters: true
filters:
  - typst-extras
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: |-
          text="$(pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | tr '\n' ' ')"
          for expected in 'Figure 1.1: First' 'Figure 1.2: Second' 'Figure 2.1: Third' 'Figure 2.2: Fourth'; do
            printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qF "$expected" || { echo "missing: $expected"; exit 1; }
          done
    typst:
      noErrors: default
---
